citations.text: Barzilai, S., & Chinn, C. A. (2018). On the goals of epistemic education: Promoting apt epistemic performance. Journal of the Learning Sciences, 27(3), 353-389.

en.general: Apt-AIR's fourth aspect: motivational dispositions and epistemic emotions that put a person in a position to know, such as caring about getting it right and enjoying finding out. They are not sufficient for knowledge on their own.

examples: A student cares enough to recheck a claim.
A group enjoys testing its model.
